item.title: GDP Grows by 0.1% In December
item.description: New figures from the Office for National Statistics show GDP increased by 0.1% in December. This follows a 0.2% rise in November and a 0.1% contraction in October… That is lower than the expected 0.2% growth. In the last quarter of 2025 services showed zero growth, production grew +1.2% and construction contracted by 2.1%. Sclerotic……
